_doc: Delo Derby v4 'Best-shot combinations' — the v3 winner (gumbel-fast5s: fixed-step ~5s epochs + Gumbel@100) is the CONTROL, and the next three lanes are COMBINATION bets, not single levers. Every lane shares the exact gumbel-fast5s base (small / sims=100 / buf 1.5M / EMA 0.99 / fixed --sgd-steps-per-epoch 64 / temp 30, non-wave async) so the ONLY delta per lane is the headline lever. These are our top-3 shots at a GREAT 9x9 player, mined from the engines that came before: (signal) KataGo-style auxiliary supervision — opponent-reply policy head + per-cell ownership head, both recorded in self-play and trained at weight 0.15; (wholeboard) KataGo global-pooling residual blocks in the latter half of the trunk, giving every cell a whole-board summary (open-three / double-threat awareness a local conv can't see); (vcf) an exact VCF (victory-by-continuous-fours) solver as a TEACHER that overwrites policy/value targets with ground-truth mate labels when a forced win exists (correctness-gated: 400-position fuzz vs an independent referee, zero false positives). Engine 'run_sweep_wall_slice': each chunk advances an idea by ONE wall-time slice via `python scripts/run_sweep.py --cell <CELL> --resume <cell_name>/checkpoints/latest.pt --max-wall-secs <slice_secs> --final-eval`; --final-eval writes a fresh eval/model_elo line INSIDE the bundle. Per-idea cap is wall-seconds (cap_wall_secs). Priority = NEVER-RUN/entry-fee first (every idea needs 2 elo points to have a Δelo/hr slope), THEN highest Δelo/HOUR (hill-climb the elo gradient; compute follows the steepest recent climber). Everyone caps; we CALL it early once decisive. 'cell' == run_sweep.CELLS key; 'cell_name' == that Cell's .name (the sweep_runs/<cell_name>/ path the derby reads). All four cells are already in run_sweep.CELLS. Rapfi (Gomocup Elo 2625) is an ABOVE-LADDER yardstick run separately on the leader, not a per-chunk anchor.

ideas.name: control
ideas.lever: CONTROL - a FRESH instance of the v3 winner (byte-identical to derby-gumbel-fast5s, new name for a clean fresh-start path + wandb timeline): fixed-step (--sgd-steps-per-epoch 64, ~5s epochs) + Gumbel@100. Every other v4 lane is read as a delta vs this exact recipe.

ideas.name: signal
ideas.lever: 'Signal-rich' COMBO - KataGo auxiliary supervision: opponent-reply policy head (--aux-opponent-reply-weight 0.15, worker --record-aux) + per-cell ownership head (--aux-ownership-weight 0.15, worker --record-ownership). Richer gradient per position; policy/value inference unchanged when heads off.

ideas.name: wholeboard
ideas.lever: 'Whole-board' COMBO - KataGo global-pooling residual blocks (--global-pool, latter-half of trunk; +4.79% params on small). mean+max over the 9x9 board -> per-channel bias, so every cell sees a whole-board summary (open-three / double-threat structure a local conv can't).

ideas.name: vcf
ideas.lever: 'VCF-taught' COMBO - exact VCF solver as a TEACHER (worker --vcf-teacher): when a forced victory-by-continuous-fours exists, overwrite the position's policy/value targets with ground-truth mate labels (value discounted 0.98 by mate distance, floor 0.90). Correctness-gated: 400-fuzz vs independent referee, zero false positives.
